items.title: Texas Instruments (TXN) May Find a Bottom Soon, Here's Why You Should Buy the Stock Now
items.summary: Texas Instruments (TXN) appears to have found support after losing some value lately, as indicated by the formation of a hammer chart. In addition to this technical chart pattern, strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in revising earnings estimates higher enhances the stock's potential for a turnaround in the near term.
